name: CHiME-4
description: A corpus for robust speech recognition in noisy environments, containing real and simulated microphone recordings of conversational speech with corresponding transcripts.
citation: Vincent, E., Watanabe, S., Nugraha, A. A., Barker, J., & Marxer, R. (2017). An Analysis of Environment, Microphone and Data Simulation Mismatches in Robust Speech Recognition. Computer Speech & Language, 46, 535–557. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.csl.2017.04.005

license.notes: The CHiME-4 corpus does not specify a standard SPDX license identifier; access and use are subject to the dataset/challenge terms. Review the upstream terms and any source-recording rights before use or redistribution.
